============================================
COPY THESE COMMANDS TO YOUR LINUX DEVICE
Run them one by one on Ubuntu (192.168.1.7)
============================================

# Step 1: Create .ssh directory
mkdir -p ~/.ssh
chmod 700 ~/.ssh

# Step 2: Add your public key
echo "ssh-rsa  jainishali@jainishs-MacBook-Air.local" >> ~/.ssh/authorized_keys

# Step 3: Set correct permissions
chmod 600 ~/.ssh/authorized_keys

# Step 4: Verify (optional)
ls -la ~/.ssh/

============================================
AFTER RUNNING THESE COMMANDS:
============================================

1. Go back to your MacBook
2. Test SSH connection:
   ssh jainishali@192.168.1.7

3. If it connects without password, you're done!
4. Restart your backend server
5. Try playing video again
